         <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3876">chos yes</rs></note><note type="editorial">Tentative identification as Nyang bran pa Chos kyi ye shes (ID:3876), gTsang nag pa's teacher</note> rgyu'i <note type="gloss">skyabs 'gro 'bras bu rkyang pa med kyi</note> dang tshogs na khyad yod pa'i phyir dang | <note type="gloss">rnaM pa 1 tu na theg chen pas</note> 'bras bu'i thob byar <expan>dkon mchog</expan> gsum char 'dod pa'i yang phyir ste ¦</seg></TEI>
